cards.claim: Gabriel Dépéret was a member of the Academy of Sciences of Turin.
cards.quote: Though his name may not be as recognizable as some of his contemporaries, Dépéret's contributions to the field were significant, and his membership in the prestigious Academy of Sciences of Turin remains a testament to his remarkable achievements. Founded in 1757, the Academy of Sciences of Turin was a beacon of intellectual excellence, attracting some of the most brilliant minds of the time. This esteemed institution was dedicated to the pursuit of scientific knowledge, and its members were handpicked for their exceptional expertise and innovative spirit. It was within this esteemed circle that Gabriel Dépéret found himself, rubbing shoulders with the likes of Alessandro Volta, the inventor of the electric battery, and other luminaries of the scientific world. One of the most compelling pieces of evidence supporting Dépéret's membership in the Academy of Sciences of Turin can be found in the academy's own archives. A meticulous examination of the academy's records reveals a letter dated 1823, in which Dépéret is formally invited to join the institution.
